_comment: Example joggo config. Load with: ./install.ps1 -ConfigFile install/joggo.config.example.json
Flags override anything in here. The installer writes the resolved object to
%ProgramData%\joggo\joggo.config.json; that file is the one the steps read.
THERE IS NO registrationToken KEY, AND THERE MUST NOT BE. The token is read from
-Token, from $env:JOGGO_TOKEN, or from a no-echo prompt, and is held in memory only.
If this file ever contains one the installer ignores it and tells you to delete it.
The values below are the defaults for a 16 GB box. guardWarnMB and guardCriticalMB
are 15% and 7.5% of RAM, which is where 2500/1200 came from on the machine they were
measured on; slots is 1 under 12 GB and 2 otherwise, and never more by default,
because past two the constraint here is disk throughput, not memory.
